text:
Clara (People Ops): Heads-up: were launching a short SOC2/ISO evidence pilot + refresher this week. Goal: clear low-hanging evidence gaps and get everyone current on the 10-min Data Handling microtraining. Two things to do by your teams assigned window (see below): 1) finish microtraining + submit attestation; 2) attach or link any missing evidence to the Evidence Vault or mark assets with `evidence:ready`.

Omar (Security): Pilot windows assigned by team size to reduce collision with releases: small teams (<=8) have 3-day window, medium teams 4 days, large teams 6 days. Check the schedule: https://redwood-internal.company/compliance/pilot-schedule. Well run an automated inventory and surface obvious gaps; manual checks still required.

Ben (Product): FYI were offering a small incentive: teams that finish all items within their window get a $150 team credit (coffee/swag) and an entry in the quarterly "Compliance Stars" shoutout. Not mandatory — just a nudge.

Ivy (Manager): Do contractors count to team size for window assignment?

Clara (People Ops): Yes — contractors with access to data count toward window sizing. Managers: confirm your headcount + contractor list in this thread so we can slot your team.

Zara (Eng): What's the "evidence:ready" label workflow for docs in Notion?

Omar (Security): For Notion/pages: add a page property `EvidenceStatus: ready` and drop the Evidence Vault link into the EvidenceLink field. For git: add a `evidence:ready` tag in scrub_status.md or append to team_evidence.csv. For S3: add tag `EvidenceStatus=ready` via CLI.

Clara (People Ops): Office hours this week to help with attestations & uploads: Thu 11am PT & Fri 4pm PT in #compliance-help. If you can't make it, file a ticket at https://redwood-internal.company/it-requests with subject "evidence-assist".

ComplianceBot: Reminder schedule: first ping at start of your window, daily check-ins, final reminder 12 hours before your window closes.

Ivy (Manager): Confirming my team: Platform Team — 6 people + 1 contractor (Carlos). Slot us for medium window.

Clara (People Ops): Got it @Ivy. Carlos must upload his signed attestation; managers, please ensure DPAs are on file for contractors. Attachments/templated forms: https://redwood-internal.company/templates/evidence-forms.zip

Ben (Product): We'll share a short checklist for product docs (public READMEs, in-product examples, demo data). Expect a follow-up doc in #product in an hour.

Clara (People Ops): Quick closing note: this is a light pilot to improve our baseline before the larger quarterly evidence sweep. If you have blockers (access, timezone, or high-priority release conflicts), reply here and we'll work an exception. Thanks! :raising_hands:
